title: An unmeasured final-check group in the write diagnostics says why as a fixed code, never its words
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Unmeasured groups carry a fixed why code and a host error code when it is one; prose, paths and secrets never appear.
Every unmeasured reason the site check gives sorts into its code.

tests: an unmeasured group says why as a fixed code and the host error code, never its words
the unmeasured reasons of the site check are sorted into their codes
